# Krita

> Krita is a free and open-source digital painting application supporting cross-platform creation with advanced features including animation, brushes, and Python scripting.

Krita is developed by the KDE community and available on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android. The project actively releases updates, engages with the community through tutorials and interviews, and maintains compatibility with various input devices like Wacom tablets.

## Key Topics

- Digital Painting
- Open Source
- Cross-Platform
- Animation
- Python API
- Brush Engines
- Free Software

- Wacom Support

- [Second Beta for Krita 4.3.0 Released](https://krita.org/en/posts/2020/second-beta-for-krita-4-3-0-released): Beta release announcement for Krita 4.3.0 with Python API improvements
- [Krita 3.1 Release Candidate](https://krita.org/en/posts/2016/krita-3-1-release-candidate): Release candidate announcement for Krita 3.1 with bug fixes
